B09.visual_intent: A claim card with a dashed 'mood' circle beside it; the mood fades and three outlined slots (Perform, Teach, Check) hang from the claim and fill with check marks.
B09.motion_claim: Mood dissolves; three method slots fill one by one on the spoken words.
B09.why: A method is moves in slots; the fill is the claim.

B10.visual_intent: Belief box 'chair holds me' rests on a conditions dial; the needle drifts out of the safe arc while the box stays unchanged; a terracotta dot marks the notice.
B10.motion_claim: Needle drifts out of the safe arc, belief box unmoved.
B10.why: The claim is about noticing a change in conditions, which a dial shows and a chair does not.

B11.visual_intent: Two schematic curves: 'looks right' rises, 'urge to check' falls; they cross at a ringed terracotta dot; 'confidence' lands as the ink word.
B11.motion_claim: The curves cross as the voice says the urge is weakest.
B11.why: Crossing curves are the claim; labelled schematic, no numerals.

B12.visual_intent: Four outlined cards (Doubt, Induction, Falsify, Slice) each with one question land on their names; a beam on two supports takes a load arrow and a check.
B12.motion_claim: Cards land on the four names, then the beam is load-tested.
B12.why: Cards in sequence match the list; the beam is the engineer analogy.

B13.visual_intent: Five belief squares are crossed off one by one leaving one; it becomes 'Claim' -> '?' -> 'Wrong if...' card with three blanks.
B13.motion_claim: Beliefs are struck off; the one kept flows through '?' to the blanks.
B13.why: Tearing down is motion; the blanks set up the next beat.

B14.visual_intent: Rebuild of the inspection figure: Success claim branches to Coverage, Inputs, Context, each with a one-line question and an evidence slot with a terracotta dot.
B14.motion_claim: Three branches grow on the three conditions the voice names.
B14.why: Branching tree is the figure; evidence slots stay open (no invented scores).

B15.visual_intent: Eight server tiles; seven tick as updated, one stays; a flag flips up and wakes a 'Power Peg 2003' card.
B15.motion_claim: Seven ticks, one missed, flag flips, old code lights.
B15.why: Eight tiles make the one-in-eight miss countable.

B16.visual_intent: A 45-minute bar fills with a head dot; three counters land: 4,000,000+ executions, 154 stocks, $460M+ lost; 'per the SEC'.
B16.motion_claim: Bar fills, counters land on their numbers.
B16.why: Numbers from the SEC order, attributed on screen.

B17.visual_intent: Two claim cards, 'Deployment succeeded' and 'Doing what we intend', with a not-equal sign; an arrow between them is stopped by a bar.
B17.motion_claim: The sign draws between the claims; the substitution arrow is blocked.
B17.runner_up: Single card pair without the arrow
B17.why: The blocked arrow shows doubt as a habit.
